To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
resonance arises primarily from adaptation and that resonance arises primarily because of a neuron’s intrinsic frequency.
the dynamic gain of neurons with two degrees of freedom can be described by a cascade of filters and that the dynamic gain can have six shapes, including resonant ones.
the dynamic gain of resonator neurons can be calculated exactly and that resonance arises primarily from intrinsic adaptation, but also from an intrinsic frequency.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the response of a neuronal system to its input, and how the response depends on the properties of the individual neurons.
the dynamic gain of resonator neurons and its relation to the intrinsic properties of these neurons.
the response of a neuron to an input signal.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
resonance is the result of a slow adaptation with an internal frequency that sharpens and adjusts the location of the resonance peak.
the dynamic gain of resonator neurons can exhibit a maximum of 6 different shapes, depending on their timescales and the frequency of the input signal.

the dynamic gain of neurons with complex dynamics can be understood in terms of a simple cascade of linear filters on the input and that resonance is a result of the interplay between intrinsic adaptation and intrinsic frequency.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have derived a complete expression for dynamic gain of a neuron model that incorporates intrinsic frequency.
we have provided the first exact solution for dynamic gain in a neuron with intrinsic dynamics.
we provide a complete account of how the intrinsic dynamics shape the population response properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the response of a neuronal network is shaped by both the intrinsic timescales of the constituent neurons and the network connectivity.
a resonator neuron is more than just a linear integrator with a resonant peak.
the response properties of neurons with intrinsic dynamics depend not only on the intrinsic dynamics, but also on the input.
